3.2 高阶线性微分方程
- n 阶线性微分方程的一般形式: y⁽ⁿ⁾ + a₁(x)y⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾ + ... + aₙ(x)y = f(x)
- 齐次 f(x)=0; 非齐次 f(x)≠0
- 齐次方程的解的结构: if y1..yn linear independent n solutions, y=C1y1+...+Cnyn is general solution.
- 非齐次方程的解的结构: nonhomogeneous general solution = homogeneous general solution + particular solution.
3.3 常系数齐次线性微分方程
- second order constant coeff homogeneous: y''+py'+qy=0
- characteristic equation r²+pr+q=0
- Cases:
1 Δ>0 distinct real roots -> y=C1e^(r1x)+C2e^(r2x)
2 Δ=0 repeated root -> y=(C1+C2x)e^(rx)
3 Δ<0 complex conjugate roots α±βi -> y=e^(αx)(C1cosβx+C2sinβx)
- generalize to n: characteristic equation has n roots, write general solution according to rules.
3.4 常系数非齐次线性微分方程
- method of undetermined coefficients: f(x)=P_m(x)e^(λx), assume particular solution y*=x^k Q_m(x)e^(λx), k multiplicity of λ as characteristic root.
- variation of parameters: given homogeneous general solution y=C1y1+C2y2, set y*=u1(x)y1+u2(x)y2, solve equations for u1', u2'
- differential equations and derivatives: core is derivative; solving is reverse from derivative to original function.
